title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Bi-Poisson vector spaces
exact_target: Determine when the variety of maximal common isotropic subspaces is smooth and how pencil automorphisms partition it into orbits.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100502 (AMR-020-0502). CC BY 4.0.

A. Bolsinov, V. S. Matveev, E. Miranda and S. Tabachnikov, Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems (2018), arXiv:1804.03737, Problem 5.3 and bi-Lagrangian definition.
